editorial.blurb: A neighborhood favorite for five years running, #1 Chop Suey delivers fresh, hot Chinese comfort food that'll make any new area feel like home.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the angel hair thin noodles with MEI chicken—reviewers say it outshines the chicken fried rice, and combo meals with egg rolls and a pop run under $16.
signatureDishes: Sweet & sour chicken with fried rice
